verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an extensive public API Reference covering monitors, dashboards, SLOs, logs, incident management, etc. plus an official CLI (datadog-ci) and MCP server, suggesting broad programmatic access, but no evidence explicitly confirms 1:1 parity between every UI action and API endpoint. missing for 10: explicit vendor statement or independent verification of full UI/API feature parity, and confirmation the OpenAPI spec covers 100% of UI capabilities (the probed openapi.json paths 404'd).
